content:
An AI agent is a software entity that can perceive its environment, take actions, and learn from experiences to achieve specific goals. It acts on behalf of humans or other agents in various applications, such as robotics, game playing, and decision-making systems.

Think of an AI agent like a virtual representative that interacts with the world according to predetermined rules and objectives. This interaction can be through text-based interfaces, visual interfaces, or even robotic actions.

To illustrate this concept, imagine a simple chatbot designed to assist users in answering questions. The chatbot is essentially an AI agent that receives inputs from users and responds accordingly. It uses its programming and learning capabilities to refine its responses over time, making it more helpful and accurate.

In essence, an AI agent is a computer system that embodies intelligence, allowing it to perform tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously in various domains.
